change_vs_2026_09_21_checkpoint.interpretation: The genuinely new threshold is the jump in measured 24h chain inflow from about $9.2M to about $505M while DEX and perp growth remain elevated. However, stablecoin stock remains negative week-over-week, so the inflow cannot yet be classified as retained speculative dollar capital.

notes: The roughly $505M 24h inflow is economically large enough to monitor, but its asset/source composition was not independently resolved in this run.
Stablecoin supply remains -2.15% over seven days, contradicting a simple thesis that fresh dollars are taking up residence on Arbitrum One.
DEX and perp growth are both elevated; perps remain very large in absolute terms, so leveraged/churn activity receives a material discount.
Raw address and transaction growth is not treated as organic-wallet confirmation without bot/HFT decomposition.

rwa_attribution.notes: RWA Active AUM is not counted as migration. No fresh Arbitrum One secondary-RWA trading, borrowing, or collateral-utilization surge was verified in this checkpoint. Robinhood Chain tokenized-stock secondary activity is economically substantive but is a separate Orbit chain and does not convert Arbitrum One RWA AUM into secondary-use evidence.

catalysts: Standard Chartered initiated ARB coverage on 2026-09-15, framing Arbitrum as TradFi/tokenization infrastructure and citing Robinhood Chain revenue.
Robinhood Chain contributes 10% of net protocol revenue to the Arbitrum ecosystem under the AEP, but that accrues to the DAO/developer ecosystem rather than automatically to ARB holders.
The tokenization narrative remains active, but current Arbitrum One inflow attribution is unresolved.

notes: Robinhood Wallet gas subsidies through late September contaminate Robinhood Chain activity used in the broader ARB narrative.
Arbitrum One trading metrics are not assumed organic merely from volume/address counts; high-frequency automated swapping is a known structural feature of the chain.

wallet_quality.notes: No fresh cohort of historically selective, independently funded ARB spot accumulators with repeat buying and checked funding independence was verified in this run.

value_capture.notes: ARB is a governance token. AEP/Robinhood revenue accrues to the DAO ecosystem; there is no verified automatic dividend, buyback, burn, or holder fee distribution tied to the current activity surge.

reasons: Official Arbitrum Foundation token specifications state that the Arbitrum One ARB contract can mint up to 2% of total supply once per year.
Official governance documentation states that the 9-of-12 Security Council can perform upgrades without delay; ordinary DAO proposals can also upgrade the system.
Only about 67.9% of the 10B maximum supply is currently circulating, leaving material scheduled/controlled supply overhang.
structural_gate.correction_note: This prospectively corrects the 2026-09-21 ARB checkpoint, which recorded PASS_WITH_GOVERNANCE_AND_SUPPLY_CAVEATS because privileged mint/upgrade authority was not surfaced then. The older record remains immutable; under the current hard-gate framework ARB is rejected for a new paper entry.

leadership_assessment: Arbitrum One has reaccelerated in capital movement and trading velocity, but ARB remains a narrative/price expression with weak direct value capture. The new chain-flow anomaly is real enough to alert, but it does not qualify as an ARB entry because retained stablecoin confirmation is absent and the structural gate fails.
major_uncertainties: Composition and source of the roughly $505M 24h inflow were not resolved.
How much of current DEX/perp activity is discretionary versus automated/high-frequency or leverage-driven remains uncertain.
RWA AUM lacks fresh secondary/collateral-utilization confirmation on Arbitrum One.
forward_tests: Identify the assets, origin chains, and destination protocols behind the current large inflow and determine whether it persists across multiple checkpoints.
Require Arbitrum One stablecoin balances to turn and remain positive rather than relying on one-day bridge flow.
Require spot/DEX breadth to persist after discounting automation and derivatives activity.
Track whether any holder-level ARB value-capture mechanism becomes concrete; DAO treasury revenue alone remains discounted.

Even if capital-quality confirmation improves, ARB remains paper-entry-ineligible unless the privileged mint/upgrade hard gate is prospectively changed by the portfolio rules or the authority itself is materially removed/constrained.
